description: Publish or rotate YOUR public keys. You make proof = Ed25519 sig (new sign key) over signing_string(kind=keys); for rotation also rotation_sig (same string, old key). Never send private keys.

agent_key.description: Your own lounge agent key (lk_...). Used for this call only, never stored. Can also be sent as the X-Agent-Key header.

ts.description: UTC ISO time you signed, e.g. 2026-10-21T03:00:00Z

name: publish_keys
